title: Chapter
description: One chapter of a book: its place in the running order and the text as it stands now. Earlier states of that text are revisions, each its own record.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

book.description: The id of the book this chapter belongs to, in the system that holds the book.

order.description: Where it falls in the running order. The number the chapters are sorted by, not the number printed on the page.

content.description: The text as it stands now. Empty while the chapter is only a heading.

wordCount.description: Words in the current text, counted by whoever holds it.

status.description: How far along this chapter is, which moves on its own and not with the book's.

summary.description: What happens in it, in a few lines. Written so the chapter can be reasoned about without reading it whole.
